# Project 34 model matrix — every model, on every box it lives on, by job (generated by `hard-bench\menu_matrix.py`)

Built 2026-11-22 11:03 from `standings.csv` (sha 0bceafc2ea8b7b57) with the placement table's own rules: 958 configs measured, 523 on the menu, 435 refused (stopped, void, never solved, or thinking-off loses). The full point cloud is `model-matrix.csv` (one row per config, every number, every rank).

**How to read a cell.** For one model on one box and one job, the three winning configs, one per lens: *best quality* = highest 95% lower bound of the solve rate, *fastest* = fewest seconds per solved answer, *least energy* = fewest joules per solved answer. A line reads `thinking · temperature · success (lower bound) · seconds per solve · joules per solve · rank among the configs ranked on that lens for that box and job`. `~` = joules estimated from seconds at the box's metered watts; `—` = no energy figure. The three lenses are never merged into one score.

**Read with care.** Compare quality only within one job. Many settings sit at 100%, so the lower bound and the other two lenses do the separating. A model's name is matched by name, not by weights: every name is mapped. 0 menu configs have no joules figure (73 are estimates).
